newsitem.title: USA: Mace Security says most shares up for sale.
newsitem.headline: Mace Security says most shares up for sale.

text.p: Mace Security International Inc said Friday it had been informed by Jon Goodrich, chairman and holder of about 29 percent of the company's common stock, and Robert Gould, a director and holder of about 27 percent, that they are each seeking offers for purchase of their shares.

Mace said each had told it that he had negotiated with the same large privately held entity that is a leading competitor of the company, but that those negotiations had ended. The company would not name the entity.
Goodrich and Gould had also informed the company that he is engaged in discussions with various other potential purchasers, including an affiliate of the large privately held entity.

While Goodrich and Gould have and will likely continue to negotiate with the same party, neither has informed Mace that they are negotiating as a group or that the sale of their respective shares is contingent on sale by the other, Mace said in a statement.
Mace produces self defense sprays for the consumer and law enforcement markets and markets consumer safety and security products.
